title: Building a B2B SaaS Partner Program with Megan Blissick #shorts
normalization: Concatenate utf8 segments per caption event; retain event start and duration; whitespace trim only.

segments.text: so you know building a valuable partner
program I think there's a couple things
have to be set up before you get in
front of Partners and that is you need
to have your value prop extremely clear
what does your product do how does it
help those customers what's the ideal
customer profile one thing I always see
in Partnerships that makes me cringe is
like you need to know who is not your
customer as well as you need to know who
is your customer because your partners
aren't going to advocate for you if it's
going to make them look bad so you
really need to have a very clear value
proposition ICP and also a way to
continuously communicate with your
entire organization you need ways to get
in front of other people other
stakeholders within the team someone
that can answer more technical questions
so having at least the infrastructure
built out is really important before
showing up to someone's store
